name: Prospero Multi Tools
description: Backup manager for PS5: browse and edit PS1 to PS5, PSP and PS Vita backups, install packages and launch PS1/PS2/PSP titles. Needs the unjail payload.
author: SvenGDK
release_notes:
A PS5 Homebrew Backup Manager & Toolkit for PS1, PS2, PS3, PS4, PS5, PSP and PS Vita backups. Browse backups, inspect and modify metadata, install PS4/PS5 packages, launch PS1/PS2/PSP titles, and more.

Please check the README for all features, information and how to use :
- https://github.com/SvenGDK/Prospero-Multi-Tools/blob/main/README.md
